recommendation_summary: Set up an external dead-man's-switch monitor that `nightly-sync` pings only after it finishes, so the user gets an email if the daily ping is missed; also fix the expired token and test the alert by deliberately skipping a ping.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker are unnecessary for alerting on this one job.
labels.Bottleneck: The script sends email only if execution reaches the email step.
labels.Checked myself: From your account, an expired token caused four startup crashes with no notification; I have not inspected either machine.

note: The reply recommends one external heartbeat alert, keeps the Synology out of the setup, and its record lines are specific to this case and grounded in the given facts.
